verdict.rationale: Datadog is an observability platform, so a local or dev instance for testing instrumentation and dashboards is a fair question for this kind of product. No first-party evidence shows a self-hosted, local or dev-instance deployment option. A community user states Datadog has no local option for verifying tracing and metrics before shipping.

support.subject: As a developer, I can spin up a local or dev instance of the platform to test instrumentation and dashboards
